Make presence absence chart with genus data
```{r}
# Start with a clean slate
rm(list=ls())

# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(pheatmap)
library(patchwork)

# Read files
metabolic_file <- paste0(
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/metabolic_output/",
  "65genus/MW-score_result_table_input.txt"
)

genus_mw_score <- read.delim(
  metabolic_file,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Convert Func1 and Func2 into one MAG x function table
#
# Each row of the original file contains a pair of metabolic
# functions. Extract each individual function occurring in
# either Func1 or Func2 for each MAG.
metabolic_long <- genus_mw_score %>%
  select(
    user_genome = `#Genome`,
    Func1,
    Func2,
    Genus = `Taxonomic Group`
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Func1, Func2),
    names_to = "function_source",
    values_to = "Function"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Function),
    Function != ""
  ) %>%
   distinct(
    user_genome,
    Genus,
    Function
  )


# Create MAG x function presence/absence table
presence_absence <- metabolic_long %>%
  select(
    user_genome,
    Genus,
    Function
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = recode(
      Genus,
      "NK_genus" = "f_CAISDR01"
    ),
    Presence = 1
  ) %>%
  complete(
    nesting(
      user_genome,
      Genus
    ),
    Function,
    fill = list(
      Presence = 0
    )
  )

# Now plot
full_plot <- ggplot(presence_absence, aes(x = Function, y = user_genome, fill = factor(Presence))) +
  geom_tile(color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "white", "1" = "black")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

```


Combine similar functions for organization
```{r}

# Define dictionary for cycle assignment
cycle_lookup <- c(
  # Carbon cycle
  "Carbon fixation" = "Carbon",
  "Fermentation" = "Carbon",
  "Organic carbon oxidation" = "Carbon",
  "Methanotrophy" = "Carbon",
  "Hydrogen generation" = "Carbon",
  "Ethanol oxidation" = "Carbon",
  "Acetate oxidation" = "Carbon",
  "Hydrogen oxidation" = "Carbon",
  
  # Nitrogen cycle
  "Nitrate reduction" = "Nitrogen",
  "Nitrite reduction" = "Nitrogen",
  "Nitric oxide reduction" = "Nitrogen",
  "Nitrous oxide reduction" = "Nitrogen",
  "Nitrite ammonification" = "Nitrogen",
  
  # Sulfur cycle
  "Sulfate reduction" = "Sulfur",
  "Sulfide oxidation" = "Sulfur",
  "Sulfite oxidation" = "Sulfur",
  "Sulfite reduction" = "Sulfur",
  "Sulfur oxidation" = "Sulfur",
  "Thiosulfate oxidation" = "Sulfur",
  "Thiosulfate disproportionation" = "Sulfur",
  
  # Iron
  "Iron oxidation" = "Iron",
  "Iron reduction" = "Iron"
)

# Some functions are broken down into more specific parts like nitrate reduction and carbon fixation, we are gonna put those back together and clean up names
presence_absence_grouped <- presence_absence %>%
  mutate(
    # Replace non-breaking spaces with normal spaces
    Function_clean = str_replace_all(
      Function,
      "\u00A0",
      " "
    ),
    
    # Remove METABOLIC function code at the beginning
    Function_clean = str_remove(
      Function_clean,
      "^[A-Za-z]+-[A-Za-z]+-[0-9]+:"
    ),
    
    # Remove anything after "(" and trim whitespace
    Function_clean = str_replace(
      Function_clean,
      "\\s*\\(.*\\)",
      ""
    ) %>%
      str_trim(),
    
    # Collapse subfunctions by taking text before " - "
    Function_group = str_extract(
      Function_clean,
      "^[^-]+"
    ) %>%
      str_trim(),
    
    # Remove trailing colon if present
    Function_group = str_replace(
      Function_group,
      ":$",
      ""
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Function_group != "Arsenite oxidation"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
  Function_group,
  Genus,
  user_genome
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Presence = as.numeric(any(Presence == 1)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Cycle = cycle_lookup[Function_group]
  )

# Order Function_group by cycle priority
presence_absence_grouped <- presence_absence_grouped %>%
  mutate(
    Cycle = factor(Cycle, levels = c("Carbon", "Nitrogen", "Sulfur", "Iron")),
    Function_group = factor(Function_group,
                            levels = unique(Function_group[order(Cycle)]))
  )

clean_plot <- ggplot(presence_absence_grouped,
                     aes(x = Function_group, y = user_genome)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = interaction(Presence, Cycle)), color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "0.Carbon"   = "white",
      "0.Nitrogen" = "white",
      "0.Sulfur"   = "white",
      "0.Iron"    = "white",
      "1.Carbon"   = "#d6a85fff",  
      "1.Nitrogen" = "#a88bc2ff", 
      "1.Sulfur"   = "#d98c73ff",
      "1.Iron"    = "#81a6a1ff"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title  = element_blank()
  )



```



Bring in relative abundance from coverm and find avg for each genus
```{r}
# Read in files
folder <- "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/coverm_65"

files <- list.files(
  path = folder,
  pattern = "\\.tsv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

data_list <- lapply(files, function(f) {
  
  dat <- read.delim(
    f,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Keep only Genome + the 3 measurements
  dat <- dat[, 1:4]
  
  # Give the columns consistent names
  colnames(dat) <- c(
    "Genome",
    "Mean",
    "Relative_Abundance",
    "Covered_Fraction"
  )
  
  dat
})

names(data_list) <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(files))

# Combine all
all_data <- bind_rows(data_list, .id = "Culture")

# Remove "coverm_" from the Culture names 
all_data <- all_data %>% mutate( Culture = sub("^coverm_", "", Culture) )


# Remove CoverM "unmapped" rows
all_data <- all_data %>%
  filter(
    !grepl("unmapped", Genome, ignore.case = TRUE)
  )


# Calculate median relative abundance for each genome
median_abundance <- all_data %>%
  group_by(Genome) %>%
  summarise(
    Median_Relative_Abundance = median(
      Relative_Abundance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(Median_Relative_Abundance)
  )

```



We want to order the genus by phylum
```{r}
# Get phylum from GTDB
gtdb <- read.delim(
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/metabolic_output/339genus/gtdbtk_Genome_files/classify/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Extract taxonomy from GTDB classification
taxonomy <- gtdb %>%
  select(user_genome, classification) %>%
  separate(
    classification,
    into = c(
      "domain",
      "phylum",
      "class",
      "order",
      "family",
      "genus",
      "species"
    ),
    sep = ";",
    fill = "right"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    domain  = str_remove(domain,  "^d__"),
    phylum  = str_remove(phylum,  "^p__"),
    class   = str_remove(class,   "^c__"),
    order   = str_remove(order,   "^o__"),
    family  = str_remove(family,  "^f__"),
    genus   = str_remove(genus,   "^g__"),
    species = str_remove(species, "^s__")
  )

# Create one genus-to-phylum lookup
genus_phylum_lookup <- taxonomy %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(genus),
    genus != "",
    !is.na(phylum),
    phylum != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    genus,
    phylum
  )

genus_phylum_lookup <- genus_phylum_lookup %>%
  filter(
    genus != "f_CAISDR01"
  ) %>%
  bind_rows(
    tibble(
      genus = "f_CAISDR01",
      phylum = "Pseudomonadota"
    )
  )

# Add phylum to genus-level presence/absence data
presence_absence_grouped <- presence_absence_grouped %>%
  left_join(
    genus_phylum_lookup,
    by = c("Genus" = "genus")
  )
```



Plots
```{r}
# Define phylum colors
phylum_colors <- c(
  "Actinomycetota"  = "#7c6f64",
  "Bacteroidota"    = "#5b7694",
  "Cyanobacteriota" = "#52796f",
  "Pseudomonadota"  = "#b45f5a",
    "Chloroflexota"   = "#C49A56"
)

phylum_order <- names(
  phylum_colors
)


# Create one annotation row for each MAG
mag_annotation <- presence_absence_grouped %>%
  distinct(
    user_genome,
    Genus,
    phylum
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    user_genome = as.character(user_genome),
    Genus = as.character(Genus)
  ) %>%
  
  # Add median relative abundance for each MAG
  left_join(
    median_abundance %>%
      mutate(
        Genome = as.character(Genome)
      ),
    by = c("user_genome" = "Genome")
  ) %>%
  
  # Set phylum order
  mutate(
    phylum = factor(
      phylum,
      levels = phylum_order
    )
  )


# Establish MAG order:
# phylum first, then descending median abundance within phylum
mag_order <- mag_annotation %>%
  arrange(
    phylum,
    desc(Median_Relative_Abundance),
    Genus,
    user_genome
  ) %>%
  pull(
    user_genome
  )


# Apply identical row order to annotation data
mag_annotation <- mag_annotation %>%
  mutate(
    user_genome = factor(
      user_genome,
      levels = rev(mag_order)
    )
  )


# Apply identical row order to metabolic data
presence_absence_grouped <- presence_absence_grouped %>%
  mutate(
    phylum = factor(
      phylum,
      levels = phylum_order
    ),
    user_genome = factor(
      user_genome,
      levels = rev(mag_order)
    )
  )


# Create phylum and genus annotation panel
phylum_plot <- ggplot(
  mag_annotation,
  aes(
    x = 1,
    y = user_genome,
    fill = phylum
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = Genus
    ),
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = phylum_colors,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    fill = "Phylum"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 0,
      r = 0,
      b = 0,
      l = 0
    )
  )


# Create user_genome column
mag_id_plot <- ggplot(
  mag_annotation,
  aes(
    x = 1,
    y = user_genome
  )
) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = user_genome
    ),
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 1.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 0,
      r = 2,
      b = 0,
      l = 2
    )
  )

# Create median relative abundance column
abundance_plot <- ggplot(
  mag_annotation,
  aes(
    x = 1,
    y = user_genome
  )
) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = sprintf(
        "%.2f",
        Median_Relative_Abundance
      )
    ),
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 1.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 0,
      r = 2,
      b = 0,
      l = 2
    )
  )

# Create metabolic presence/absence matrix
clean_plot <- ggplot(
  presence_absence_grouped,
  aes(
    x = Function_group,
    y = user_genome
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    aes(
      fill = interaction(
        Presence,
        Cycle
      )
    ),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "0.Carbon"   = "white",
      "0.Nitrogen" = "white",
      "0.Sulfur"   = "white",
      "0.Iron"     = "white",
      "1.Carbon"   = "#d6a85f",
      "1.Nitrogen" = "#a88bc2",
      "1.Sulfur"   = "#d98c73",
      "1.Iron"     = "#81a6a1"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

# Combine genus, MAG ID, abundance, and metabolic matrix
combined_plot <-
  phylum_plot +
  mag_id_plot +
  abundance_plot +
  clean_plot +
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(
      2.0,
      2.4,
      0.8,
      12
    ),
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

combined_plot
```
